name: pi-tools-verbose-low
description: Pi tool rows: one line per call, or one row per run of calls with /tool-verbose low

scripts.link-pi: ln -sfn "$HOME/.pi/agent/install/releases/$(cat "$HOME/.pi/agent/install/current-version")/node_modules" pi_modules && mkdir -p node_modules/@earendil-works && ln -sfn ../../pi_modules/@earendil-works/pi-tui node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-tui && ln -sfn ../../pi_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
